package modeltest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/alicebob/miniredis/v2"
	"github.com/huandu/go-sqlbuilder"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/polpo-space/pzero/core/stores/condition"
	"github.com/polpo-space/pzero/core/stores/modelx"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/cache"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/redis"
	"github.com/zeromicro/go-zero/core/stores/sqlx"

	"example.com/modeltest/internal/model/ticket_messages"
	"example.com/modeltest/internal/model/tickets"
	"example.com/modeltest/internal/model/typed_arrays"
)

func TestPostgresBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	originalFlavor := sqlbuilder.DefaultFlavor
	conn := modelx.MustNewConn(sqlx.SqlConf{DriverName: os.Getenv("PZERO_TEST_DRIVER"), DataSource: os.Getenv("PZERO_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN")})
	if sqlbuilder.DefaultFlavor != originalFlavor {
		t.Fatal("opening a PostgreSQL connection changed the global SQL dialect")
	}
	db, err := conn.RawDB()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(5)
	redisServer := miniredis.RunT(t)
	options := modelx.WithCacheConf(cache.CacheConf{{RedisConf: redis.RedisConf{Host: redisServer.Addr(), Type: "node"}, Weight: 100}})
	model := tickets.NewTicketsModel(conn, options)
	messages := ticket_messages.NewTicketMessagesModel(conn, options)
	arrays := typed_arrays.NewTypedArraysModel(conn, options)
	fixtures := [][]string{nil, {}, {"https://example.com/image.png", "", "NULL", "a,b", `a"b`, `a\b`, "{braces}", "中文 空格"}}
	var lockedID int64
	for i, images := range fixtures {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("array_%d", i), func(t *testing.T) {
			row := &tickets.Tickets{TicketSn: fmt.Sprintf("ticket-%d", i), ConsumerId: int64(i + 1), OrderSn: fmt.Sprintf("order-%d", i), ImageUrls: images, Status: 1}
			if err := model.Insert(ctx, nil, row); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if row.Id == 0 {
				t.Fatal("identity primary key was not returned")
			}
			got, err := model.FindOne(ctx, nil, row.Id)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual([]string(got.ImageUrls), images) {
				t.Fatalf("array roundtrip: got %#v, want %#v", got.ImageUrls, images)
			}
			if _, err := model.FindOne(ctx, nil, row.Id); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			} // cached read where enabled
			message := &ticket_messages.TicketMessages{TicketId: row.Id, ImageUrls: images}
			if err := messages.Insert(ctx, nil, message); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			messageRow, err := messages.FindOne(ctx, nil, message.Id)
			if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual([]string(messageRow.ImageUrls), images) {
				t.Fatalf("message roundtrip: %#v %v", messageRow, err)
			}
			// Both full and field updates must pass the array's driver.Valuer.
			row.ImageUrls = []string{"updated", `quote"slash\`}
			if err := model.Update(ctx, nil, row); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got, err = model.FindOne(ctx, nil, row.Id)
			if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual([]string(got.ImageUrls), []string(row.ImageUrls)) {
				t.Fatalf("array update: %#v %v", got, err)
			}
			if err := model.UpdateFieldsByCondition(ctx, nil, map[string]any{"image_urls": tickets.Tickets{ImageUrls: images}.ImageUrls}, condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.Id, row.Id).Build()...); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got, err = model.FindOne(ctx, nil, row.Id)
			if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual([]string(got.ImageUrls), images) {
				t.Fatalf("array field update: %#v %v", got, err)
			}
			lockedID = row.Id
		})
	}
	t.Run("other_array_types", func(t *testing.T) {
		row := &typed_arrays.TypedArrays{Flags: []bool{true, false}, Counters: []int64{1, -2, 9007199254740993}, Weights: []float64{1.25, -2.5}}
		if err := arrays.Insert(ctx, nil, row); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := arrays.FindOne(ctx, nil, row.Id)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(row, got) {
			t.Fatalf("typed arrays: %#v %v", got, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("bulk_insert", func(t *testing.T) {
		rows := []*tickets.Tickets{
			{TicketSn: "bulk-1", ConsumerId: 101, OrderSn: "bulk-1", ImageUrls: []string{"a,b"}},
			{TicketSn: "bulk-2", ConsumerId: 102, OrderSn: "bulk-2", ImageUrls: []string{}},
		}
		if err := model.BulkInsert(ctx, nil, rows); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := model.FindByCondition(ctx, nil, condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.TicketSn, "bulk-1").Build()...)
		if err != nil || len(got) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual([]string(got[0].ImageUrls), []string{"a,b"}) {
			t.Fatalf("bulk array: %#v %v", got, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("affected_rows_and_rollback", func(t *testing.T) {
		where := condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.Id, lockedID).Equal(tickets.Status, 1).Build()
		rows, err := model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, nil, map[string]any{"status": 2}, where...)
		if err != nil || rows != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("first transition: %d %v", rows, err)
		}
		rows, err = model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, nil, map[string]any{"status": 2}, where...)
		if err != nil || rows != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("repeated transition: %d %v", rows, err)
		}
		got, err := model.FindOne(ctx, nil, lockedID)
		if err != nil || got.Status != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("cache invalidation: %#v %v", got, err)
		}
		abort := errors.New("rollback transaction")
		err = conn.TransactCtx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, session sqlx.Session) error {
			where := condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.Id, lockedID).Equal(tickets.Status, 2).Build()
			rows, err := model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, session, map[string]any{"status": 3}, where...)
			if err != nil || rows != 1 {
				return fmt.Errorf("transaction update: %d %w", rows, err)
			}
			return abort
		})
		if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err = model.FindOneByCondition(ctx, nil, condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.Id, lockedID).Build()...)
		if err != nil || got.Status != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("transaction did not roll back: %#v %v", got, err)
		}
		if rows, err := model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, nil, nil, where...); err != nil || rows != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("empty update: %d %v", rows, err)
		}
		if _, err := model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, nil, map[string]any{"unknown_column": 1}, where...); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("SQL error swallowed")
		}
	})
	t.Run("concurrent_compare_and_set", func(t *testing.T) {
		const contenders = 8
		type outcome struct {
			rows int64
			err  error
		}
		start, results := make(chan struct{}), make(chan outcome, contenders)
		for range contenders {
			go func() {
				<-start
				rows, err := model.UpdateFieldsByConditionAffected(ctx, nil,
					map[string]any{"status": 4},
					condition.NewChain().Equal(tickets.Id, lockedID).Equal(tickets.Status, 2).Build()...,
				)
				results <- outcome{rows: rows, err: err}
			}()
		}
		close(start)
		var affected int64
		for range contenders {
			result := <-results
			if result.err != nil {
				t.Errorf("competing update: %v", result.err)
			}
			affected += result.rows
		}
		if affected != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("concurrent state transitions: got %d affected rows, want 1", affected)
		}
		got, err := model.FindOne(ctx, nil, lockedID)
		if err != nil || got.Status != 4 {
			t.Fatalf("state after concurrent updates: %#v %v", got, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("transaction_lock_and_cache_bypass", func(t *testing.T) {
		if _, err := model.FindOneForUpdate(ctx, nil, lockedID); !errors.Is(err, modelx.ErrTransactionRequired) {
			t.Fatalf("missing session: %v", err)
		}
		if _, err := model.FindOne(ctx, nil, lockedID); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Deliberately make the cache stale: a locking read must still fetch PostgreSQL.
		if _, err := conn.ExecCtx(ctx, `UPDATE tickets SET status = 9 WHERE id = $1`, lockedID); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		acquired, release, finished := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{}), make(chan error, 1)
		go func() {
			finished <- conn.TransactCtx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, session sqlx.Session) error {
				got, err := model.FindOneForUpdate(ctx, session, lockedID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if got.Status != 9 {
					return fmt.Errorf("locking read used cache: status=%d", got.Status)
				}
				close(acquired)
				select {
				case <-release:
					return nil
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return ctx.Err()
				}
			})
		}()
		t.Cleanup(func() {
			close(release)
			if err := <-finished; err != nil {
				t.Errorf("holding transaction: %v", err)
			}
		})
		select {
		case <-acquired:
		case err := <-finished:
			finished <- err
			t.Fatalf("did not acquire lock: %v", err)
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
		}
		err := conn.TransactCtx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, session sqlx.Session) error {
			if _, err := session.ExecCtx(ctx, `SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '100ms'`); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			_, err := model.FindOneForUpdate(ctx, session, lockedID)
			return err
		})
		var pgErr *pgconn.PgError
		if !errors.As(err, &pgErr) || pgErr.Code != "55P03" {
			t.Fatalf("competing transaction did not encounter the row lock: %v", err)
		}
	})
}
